title: VendPoint Substitute Placement for Retired Items — Desk Reference and Add Entry
content:
## Placing a substitute

The retired item is the item of the customer's contract price line written as a removal carrying the highest change reference on the customer's agreement, and its substitute is the item of the customer's contract price line written as a Corbett-approved substitute for a discontinued item carrying the highest change reference (both are change lines, whose references Corbett issues in sequence).

When the retired item still stands in a selection of the machine, its selection entry carrying the highest planogram request reference being an add or a par change and not a removal, and the substitute stands in no selection of the machine, Corbett places the substitute in the retired item's selection: it records an add entry from Corbett dated the day of placement, under the retired item's selection label, for the substitute's product category, at the par figured below; the substitute takes the retired item's place in that selection at the next restock visit like any other selection change, and Corbett-initiated changes never count toward the included changes.

The substitute's par is fixed only after the retired item's stock ledger stands at zero or above.

This placement is part of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program; the retired item and its substitute are read from the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement.

### Scope at a glance

| Condition | What the records show |
|---|---|
| The retired item still stands in a selection of the machine | Its selection entry carrying the highest planogram request reference is an add or a par change, not a removal |
| The substitute stands in no selection of the machine | No selection of the machine holds the substitute |
| Both conditions hold | Corbett places the substitute in the retired item's selection, under that selection's label |

## The add entry: `place_substitute_selection_72f4b244`

**Capability.** The tool records an item placed by Corbett into one selection of a VendPoint machine: a new selection history entry of type add item assigns the named item to the named selection at the par quantity given, marked as a Corbett change, dated today and carrying the next planogram request reference in sequence, one above the highest planogram request reference on record. The item's product category is copied from the customer's contract price line for that item, and the entry is marked as a catalog item.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls `place_substitute_selection_72f4b244` with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `vending_machine_id` | The reference number of the VendPoint machine placement whose selection receives the item, as returned by the machine lookup |
| `slot_label` | The label of the selection (door, coil or bay) exactly as it appears on the machine's selection history entries, copied character for character |
| `sku` | The Corbett item number placed in the selection exactly as it appears on the customer's contract price lines, copied character for character |
| `par_qty` | The par quantity of the selection: a whole number of units, zero or more, with no decimal part |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` with the text `item_added`, `vending_slot_id` (the new selection history entry), `vending_machine_id`, `slot_label` and `sku` echoed back, `product_category` (the category copied for the item), `par_qty` (the par as an integer number of units), `change_reference` (the planogram request reference issued, letters VPC, a hyphen and six digits) and `effective_date` (the date of the entry in YYYY-MM-DD form).
